paite: Ginom a migenthei, mihau amukte kilawm lou gen leh mihai sang in ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

paite: Huai lou in, kha theihna bei a a-om ding ahoih kei; huan kuapeuh akhe man-gang akhial nak hi.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

paite: Mihing haina in alampi ahihsia a; huan alungtang in TOUPA ahek hi.
english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.

paite: Hausakna in lawmte tampi abehlap a; himahleh alawm a kipan migenthei khen in a-om.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

paite: Theihpih taklou gawt louh in a-om kei ding; huan kuapeuh zuaugen asuakta kei ding.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

paite: Mi tampi in misiam deihsakna angen ding ua; huan michih thilpiakte pia a ding in lawm ahi.
english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

paite: Migenthei unaute tengteng in amah ahua ua; amah a kipan bangchi a gamla in ahia alawmte apai uh! Thute in amau adelh a, himahleh apai khin uhi.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

paite: Kuapeuh pilna mu in akha a-it a; kuapeuh theihsiamna kem in hoih amu ding hi.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

paite: Theihpih taklou gawt louh in a-om kei ding a; kuapeuh zuaugen amangthang ding.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

paite: Mihai a ding in nuamtat akilawm kei a; lalte tung a sikha vaihawm akilawm kei sem hi.
english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

paite: Mihing ngentelna in amah ahehhaksak a; huan atatlekna paikan athupina ahi.
english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

paite: Kumpipa thangpaihna humpinelkai humham bang ahi; himahleh adeihsakna loupa tung a daitui bang ahi.
english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

paite: Tapa hai apa tuahsiatna ahi; huan zi hanhat a-intung keh gige ahi.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

paite: Inn leh hauhsaknate nu leh pate a kipan gouluah ahi; himahleh zi pil TOUPA a kipan ahi.
english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.

paite: Thadahna nakpi a ihmutna ah apai a; huan mithadah in gilkial athuak ding.
english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

paite: Kuapeuh thupiak zui in akha akem a; himahleh kuapeuh alampite a pilvang lou asi ding.
english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei hehpihna nei in TOUPA a ding in aleitawisak a, huan athil hoih hih amah adin nawn ding.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.

paite: Lametna a-om lai in na tapa sawi in; huan akah ziak in na kha in khawlsan mawk ke'n.
english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

paite: Nakpitak a thangpaimi in gawtna athuak ding; amah na hutkhiakleh, huai tuh na hihkik nawn kul ding ahi ngal a.
english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

paite: Thupha za inla, hilhna sang in, na hinkhua nanung a na piltheihna ding in.
english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

paite: Mihing lungtang ah thugel tampi a-om a; himahleh TOUPA thuhilhna, huai mah adingh ding hi.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

paite: Mihing deihthusam amigitna tehna ahi; huan migenthei mizuauthei sang in ahoihzaw hi.
english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

paite: TOUPA kihtak hinna lam zotna ahi; huan kuapeuh huai nei lungkim in a-om gige ding; gilou veh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

paite: Mithadah in kuang sung ah akhut aphum a, huchi in akam ah huai ahon tun nawn ngap kei hi.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

paite: Simmohhat sat in, mimawl in pilvandan asin ding; theihsiamna nei sal in, huchi in theihna atheisiam ding hi.
english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

paite: Kuapeuh apa tung a hiamgam a, anu delhmang, zumna omsak leh simmohna tun tapa ahi.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

paite: Theihna thute a kipan a lampial lel ding in, ka tapa, hilhna zak tawp in.
english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

paite: Theihpihmi phattuamna nei lou in vaihawmna asimmoh; huan migilou kam in thulimlouhna anawmvalh hi.
english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

paite: Muhsit hatmi a ding in vaihawmnate bawlkholhsa ahi, mihai nungzang a ding in vuaknate.
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
